ai.title: Add CACHEDEBUGFULLLOGGING flag for prompt cache debugging
ai.summary: Added `CACHE_DEBUG_FULL_LOGGING` constant in `packages/agent-runtime/src/constants.ts` to enable full LLM request logging. When active, `run-agent-step.ts` hashes system prompts and tool definitions, writing JSON snapshots to `debug/cache-debug/` via new `util/cache-debug.ts`. A companion script `scripts/compare-cache-debug.ts` diffs these snapshots to identify prompt cache invalidation sources. Scope limited to agent-runtime internals; no user-facing UI changes.

eli5.text: Developers working on the agent code can now flip a hidden switch to save a full copy of every prompt the system sends to the AI, including instructions and available tools, into a folder called debug/cache-debug. A separate tool then line up any two of those saved prompts side by side and highlights the exact spot where they differ, so the team can spot why the AI's prompt cache is being busted and fix the cause. The switch starts off, so nothing changes for anyone running the software today, but the machinery is wired in and ready for debugging.

ai.title: Wrap knowledge files comparison in MarkdownTable component
ai.summary: Replaced raw markdown table syntax in `web/src/content/tips/knowledge-files.mdx` with `<MarkdownTable>` component tags. This fixes rendering issues for the Home Directory vs Project knowledge files comparison table. Scope limited to the tips documentation page.

eli5.text: If you open the tips page that compares your personal coding preferences to project-specific settings, the side-by-side chart now displays correctly instead of showing raw formatting symbols. The fix wraps that one table in new markup so your browser renders the rows and columns neatly. Only readers of that single documentation page notice the change.
